cuerpo:
This document embodies the vision of the city we want, the areas of intervention and the strategic objectives on which we must focus to make it a reality.

This shared vision is the result of a collective work that involved various actors of society (neighbors, social organizations, technicians) and that allowed us to plan management, identify the most urgent problems to solve and the medium and long-term public policies that must be implemented in order to build the city in which all "tucumanos" want to live.
